claims.enterprise_claim: For a declared finite support context K=(C,S,I), common-support derivations P(C)<->P(S) are antitone, satisfy A⊆A'' and A'''=A', and double derivation is a closure operator.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Finite object set C, support set S, incidence relation I.
hypothesis_comparison.external: Finite formal context with objects, attributes and a binary incidence relation.
hypothesis_comparison.mapping: C=objects, S=attributes, I=formal-context relation; Enterprise perpendicular is FCA prime derivation.

claims.consequence: Delete generic Galois/closure mathematics from the GEO6 novelty surface.

claims.enterprise_claim: Raw common-support duality is a typed two-sort closure duality; restricting to double-derivation-closed objects yields the lossless concept-level correspondence.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Two sorts C and S with relation I; closed means A=A''.
hypothesis_comparison.external: FCA extents/intents are double-prime closed and paired by derivation.
hypothesis_comparison.mapping: Enterprise closed Cell/support objects are FCA extents/intents.

claims.consequence: Do not claim concept closure or closed-object duality as new.

claims.enterprise_claim: If a common-support endomap D on every subset of a finite self-dual carrier is antitone and D^2=id, then D(A)=C\pi(A) for a unique permutation pi, with D^2=id iff pi^2=id.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: D is a common-support antitone involution on the entire powerset P(C).
hypothesis_comparison.external: Finite Boolean algebra is a powerset of its atoms; order automorphisms are determined by the induced atom permutation, while complement reverses order.
hypothesis_comparison.derivation: Let c be Boolean complement. c∘D is an order automorphism, hence induced by a unique atom permutation pi. Therefore D=c∘pi. Complement commutes with pi, so D^2=pi^2.

claims.consequence: The all-subset involution theorem is a routine specialization of finite Boolean-lattice structure, not a new geometry.

claims.enterprise_claim: Within that all-subset involutive class, |D(A)|=n-|A| and M(A)=|A||D(A)|=k(n-k), with nonempty proper minimum n-1 and maximum floor(n^2/4).

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Same MAH-03 hypotheses plus cardinality complexity.
hypothesis_comparison.external: Powerset/complement arithmetic on a finite n-element carrier.
hypothesis_comparison.derivation: Permutation preserves cardinality and complement has size n-k; extrema follow from elementary quadratic arithmetic.

claims.consequence: Kill any continuation whose only content is the k(n-k) law or its extremizers.

claims.enterprise_claim: The exact six-point complement, diagonal and C6 closed-neighborhood contexts have incompatible closed-object cardinality-product spectra {5,8,9}, {1}, and {3,4}.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Three explicit six-point incidence contexts and the particular functional |A||A'|.
hypothesis_comparison.external: FCA supplies the context/closure language but does not canonically single out these three benchmark spectra.

claims.consequence: Retain only as an exact finite countermodel package; absence of a matched table is not a novelty certificate.

claims.enterprise_claim: Finite incidence plus symmetry alone does not force a nontrivial relation-independent lower bound for the chosen closed-object cardinality product.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Universal assertion ranges over finite incidence contexts; diagonal contexts give product 1 at arbitrary carrier size.
hypothesis_comparison.external: FCA deliberately allows arbitrary formal contexts and provides no universal Mahler-style cardinality product invariant.

claims.consequence: The exact no-go is supported internally by elementary countermodels; it should not be advertised as a new general FCA theorem.

claims.enterprise_claim: For direct inclusion i:C_n→C_m under complement duality, D_m(i(A))=i(D_n(A))∪(C_m\i(C_n)); the refinement defect is exactly the newly introduced labels and has size m-n.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Complement duality is reused at two finite resolutions connected by an inclusion.
hypothesis_comparison.external: Finite Boolean/powerset complement and set image operations are standard.
hypothesis_comparison.derivation: Split C_m\i(A) into i(C_n\A) and C_m\i(C_n).

claims.consequence: The formula is elementary bookkeeping; the P000-specific question is which refinement transport, if any, should be native.

claims.enterprise_claim: Bare P000 does not canonically choose which native relation should serve as support I(c,s).

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Support relation is sought as derived/native data.
hypothesis_comparison.external: FCA takes the formal context relation as input data and does not provide a selector from unrelated P000 primitives.

claims.enterprise_claim: Bare P000 does not canonically identify Cell objects with support objects so as to turn the typed Galois pair into a same-sort endoduality.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: A canonical equivariant identification C≈S would be extra structure.
hypothesis_comparison.external: FCA is intrinsically object/attribute two-sorted; derivations switch sorts and concept pairs encode the relation without providing a canonical object=attribute identity.

claims.enterprise_claim: The finite relational cardinality product is only an analogy to classical Mahler volume product, not an identified instance of it.

hypothesis_comparison.enterprise: Finite Cell/support relation, no Euclidean metric, no convex body, no polar body, no volume.
hypothesis_comparison.external: Classical volume product is defined for convex bodies K in R^n using volume and polarity (with translation/centering in the nonsymmetric case).

claims.consequence: No classical Mahler inequality or extremizer transfers into P000 at current typing strength.

residue_map.reason: External FCA assumes a context relation; accepted P000 data still do not canonically select one.
Standard derivation is two-sorted; no accepted P000 datum canonically identifies Cell and support sorts.
Cardinality gives definition-driven/context-dependent products, while classical volume product requires convex-polar-volume structure not mapped to P000.
Naive direct inclusion has an exact complement defect; no accepted native support-transport rule removes it.
